About these 12 rides

They ride on 6 days of the week; Thursday has the most, with 4; only Wednesday has none. The earliest start is GSD Saturday Ride at 7:00 am; the latest is Percy Warner Night Ride at 7:00 pm. After work, 6 roll on a weekday evening. The group waits for everyone on 3 of them (no-drop), and beginners are welcome on 5. There’s one ride made for women, trans and femme riders and 1 for BIPOC riders. Each one was checked at its source between Sep 18 and Nov 9, 2026.
